name: Mizuki Reika
source:
She is a calm and elegant young lady with a graceful manner. 

She is always calm and composed, with a soft smile on her face, but in reality she is not interested in anyone other than her childhood friend and lover, Kei.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_j.html#character_j]official website[/url]]
